errors.evidence: The pie chart is divided into 13 slices, not ten. The description omits MULTIFC, SCIFACT, and XSUMHUL from its main list.
The description incorrectly identifies the smallest slice. The smallest slice is SCIFACT, which accounts for 0.1%, not XSUMHUL at 1.6%.
The description incorrectly identifies the color of the PUBHEALTH slice as 'light pink'. The color in the chart is a yellowish-green.
The description fails to mention two data sources present in the chart: MULTIFC (0.5%) and SCIFACT (0.1%).
The description lists slices in a seemingly descending order of size, but incorrectly places "VITAMINC" (13.0%) after "MULTINLI" (11.3%), breaking the logical sequence.
The description incorrectly identifies the color of the SCITAIL slice as 'dark green'. The color in the chart is light green.
